text.p: -- J.P. Morgan Securities Inc said it downgraded Wendy's International Inc to long-term buy from buy.
-- said the pricing actions to be taken by McDonald's Corp beginning in April may "affect" Wendy's sales and earnings over the next six months.
-- said "every one percent of top-line growth sacrificed to competitive pricing on an annualized basis will result in an estimated $0.05 hit to earnings."
-- expects Wendy's to post less than two percent growth in comparable store sales in 1997.
-- expects Wendy's will outperform the market over the long term. Said has "high degree of confidence" in Wendy's management team.
-- expects Wendy's to increase its presence in Venezuela, Argentina, Japan and the United Kingdom in 1997.
